name: antioch
description: Write local Python and run native Isaac on Antioch cloud GPUs: create projects, research APIs, inspect live images, improve simulations, and evaluate recorded scenarios

interface.shortDescription: Build and evaluate simulations with Antioch
interface.longDescription: Start in an empty folder or an existing robotics project. Write native Isaac Python without a local simulator install, run it on Antioch cloud GPUs, inspect images and state, improve the code, and evaluate scenarios and suites from recorded evidence.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this robotics stack and design an Antioch scenario to evaluate it.
Research the exact simulation APIs this change needs, implement it, and validate it on Antioch.
Run this suite on Antioch and explain the failures from the recorded evidence.
